DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 店について相談したいのですが、看板の名前と書類の事業者名が違います。別の店の資料だと思って捨てる前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 看板と書類の事業者名が違い資料を捨てる前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to ask about a shop, but the name on its sign differs from the business name on the paperwork. Before throwing the documents away thinking they belong to another shop, I'd like to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the business names on the sign and paperwork differ and that you want advice before discarding the documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 看板と書類では、住所は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the address on the sign the same as on the paperwork?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ住所です。ただ、住所が同じだけで同じ事業者だと断定せず、書類の名称も伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所は同じだが同一事業者と断定せず双方名称を伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it's the same address. But I don't want to conclude they're the same business just because of that; I'd like to give you the name on the paperwork too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that the addresses match but you will give both names without assuming they are the same business.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 両方の名前をメモできますか。相談先を探す際の手がかりになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you note down both names? That will help us find the appropriate place for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。看板名はこちら、書類に書かれた名前はこちらです。どちらか一方に統一して書き換えず、そのまま残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 両名を区別してメモし一つに書き換えないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. This is the name on the sign, and this is the name on the documents. I'll keep them as they are rather than changing them to a single name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will note the two names separately without changing them into one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どのような内容を相談したいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: What would you like to discuss about the shop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 購入後の連絡先が分からないことです。名前の違いを不正だと言いたいのではなく、連絡先を確かめる方法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 目的は購入後の連絡先確認で名称差を不正と主張したいのでないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't know whom to contact after my purchase. I'm not saying the different names mean wrongdoing; I want to know how to check the contact information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that your purpose is to check the contact details after purchase, not to claim the name difference is fraudulent.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この窓口では二つの名前の事業者の関係までは判断できません。購入後の連絡先について相談する担当へ、看板名と書類名の両方をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: This desk cannot determine the relationship between the businesses with those two names. We'll pass both the sign name and the document name to the staff handling inquiries about contact details after purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。看板の写真と書類を両方持ち、名称が違うことと連絡先が不明なことを分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両資料を持ち名称差と連絡先不明を分けて相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I'll bring both the photo of the sign and the documents, and explain the different names separately from the missing contact details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will bring both items and discuss the name difference and unknown contact details separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 連絡先が不明なことと、二つの名称があることを相談担当へ引き継ぎます。写真と書類はお手元に残してお待ちください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on to the adviser that the contact information is unknown and that there are two names. Please keep the photo and documents with you while you wait. Thank you for coming to us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付でお困りのことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything you need help with at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 付き添いの人に番号を伝え間違えました。自分の番号が呼ばれたのに気付かなかったかもしれません。今の状況を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同伴者へ番号を誤伝達し呼出を逃した可能性の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I gave the person accompanying me the wrong number. I may not have noticed when my own number was called. Could you check the current situation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a check because you gave your companion the wrong number and may have missed your call.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 番号の紙はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have your number slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。私が四十二番と伝えましたが、紙には二十四番と書いてあります。付き添いの人は四十二番を聞いていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙は二十四だが四十二と伝え同伴者が違う番号を待ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. I told them forty-two, but the slip says twenty-four. The person with me was listening for forty-two.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the slip says twenty-four but you said forty-two, so your companion was waiting for the wrong number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 紙の番号で状況を確認します。呼ばれた時に席を離れていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check using the number on the slip. Had you left your seat when you were called?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ずっと待合室にいました。席を外したから聞けなかったのでなく、違う番号を待っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 席を離れず違う番号を待ったため聞けなかったと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was in the waiting room the whole time. It wasn't that I couldn't hear because I'd left; I was waiting for a different number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you did not leave your seat and missed the call because you were waiting for the wrong number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認したところ、二十四番は先ほど一度お呼びしています。改めてご案内しますのでお待ちください。付き添いの方にも番号の紙を見せられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've checked, and we called twenty-four once a little while ago. Please wait; we'll call you again. Can you show your companion the number slip too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。口頭で言い直すだけでなく、一緒に紙を見ます。付き添いの人の番号ではなく、患者の私の番号だと確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 口頭だけでなく同伴者と患者本人の紙の番号を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Rather than just correcting it verbally, we'll look at the slip together. We'll check that it's my number as the patient, not my companion's number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you and your companion will check the patient's own number on the slip, not just correct it verbally.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それでは、こちらでお待ちください。番号の紙は捨てないでくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait here, then. Don't throw away your number slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手元に持って待ちます。次に呼ばれたら紙と照合し、聞き違いがあれば推測で進まず受付へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紙を保持し呼出と照合し不明なら受付へ確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep it with me while I wait. When a number is called next, I'll compare it with the slip, and if I may have misheard, I'll check at reception instead of guessing and going ahead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will keep the slip, compare it with the call, and ask reception if anything is unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 患者さんの番号は二十四番で、改めてのご案内を待つことを確認できました。紙をお手元に残し、付き添いの方と一緒にこちらでお待ちください。お知らせありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've confirmed that the patient's number is twenty-four and that you will wait to be called again. Keep the slip with you and wait here together with your companion. Thank you for letting us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What seems to be the problem?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: なくした物の位置が電話に表示されています。ただ、この点の近くにいる人が持っていると決めて、声をかけてよいのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 位置表示近くの人が所持者と断定して声をかけてよいか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The location of something I lost is showing on my phone. But I'm unsure whether it's okay to assume a person near that point has it and approach them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can approach someone near the displayed location on the assumption that they have your item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 近くの人へ決めつけた声がけはしないでください。表示の更新時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please don't approach people nearby with that assumption. Do you know when the location was last updated?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一時間前です。今の位置のように見ていましたが、最新とは限りません。物がそこにあることもまだ自分では確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 更新は一時間前で現在位置や実物を未確認と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: An hour ago. I was treating it as the current location, but it may not be up to date. I haven't personally confirmed that the item is there either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that the update was an hour ago and that neither the current location nor the item itself has been confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示だけと、実際に見た事実を分けましょう。最後に物を使った場所は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's distinguish what the display shows from what you've actually seen. Do you remember where you last used the item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅前のベンチです。その後に位置表示を見ました。誰かが拾うところを見たわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最後に駅前ベンチで使い拾う人は見ていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: On a bench outside the station. I checked the location display after that. I didn't actually see anyone pick it up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you last used it on a bench outside the station and did not see anyone pick it up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その経過を伺います。物の特徴は説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ask you about that sequence of events. Can you describe the item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 灰色の小さなケースで、内側に名前を書いてあります。外から名前が見える物ではないので、似たケースを見てもすぐ自分の物と決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 灰色ケース内側の名前の特徴を示し似た外観で所有を断定しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's a small gray case with my name written inside. The name isn't visible from outside, so even if I see a similar case, I won't immediately decide it's mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe in Japanese the gray case with your name inside and say you will not assume ownership just because a case looks similar.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。遺失物としての相談に必要な情報を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I'll check the information needed for a lost-property inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。最後に使った場所、物の特徴、表示の時刻を別々に伝えます。近くの人を相手に取り返そうとはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 利用場所特徴表示時刻を分けて伝え人へ取り返しに行かないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I'll give the place I last used it, its features, and the time of the displayed location separately. I won't try to take it back from people nearby.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will separately report where you used it, its features and the display time, and will not go to take it back from someone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できた経過と物の特徴として承りました。位置表示の情報も分けて記録します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've taken down the confirmed sequence of events and the item's features. I'll record the displayed location information separately too. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。郵便のことでお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with the mail?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 贈り物の宛名に、相手の名前と私の名前を並べて書きました。「私からです」と伝えるつもりでしたが、誰宛てか分かりにくくなっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宛名へ受取人と自分の名前を並べ誰宛か曖昧になったと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote both the recipient's name and my own together in the address on a gift. I meant to say it was from me, but now it's unclear who it's addressed to.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that putting the recipient's and your own names together has made the addressee unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受け取る方は、お一人ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、友人一人です。私へ届けてほしいわけではなく、送り主として名前を伝えたかっただけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取は友人一人で自分は送り主として示したかったと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, one friend. I don't want it delivered to me; I only wanted to give my name as the sender.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that your friend alone is the recipient and that you only intended to identify yourself as the sender.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受取人と差出人は分けて記入します。差出人用の場所は確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The recipient and sender should be written separately. Can you find the space for the sender?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらの欄ですね。自分の名前はこちらへ書き、宛名に並べた私の名前は直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 差出人欄へ自分の名を書き宛名の自分の名を直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's this field, isn't it? I'll write my name here and correct the part where I put my own name alongside the recipient's.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will put your name in the sender field and correct your name in the address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書き直す前に、受取人の住所も確認してください。どちらの住所を記入しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before rewriting it, please check the recipient's address too. Whose address did you write?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 住所は友人の家です。自分の住所ではありません。名前だけ役割を混ぜたので、住所まで全部変えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 住所は友人の家で名前の役割だけ直し住所全部は変更しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's my friend's home address, not mine. I mixed up only the roles of the names, so I'll make sure I don't change the whole address as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that the address is your friend's home and you will correct only the names' roles rather than changing the entire address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それで確認できます。贈り物のメッセージは、宛名の記載とは別に入れられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: That lets us check it. You can put a message with the gift separately from the address information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。「私から」という言葉は中のカードに書きます。宛名は友人、差出人は私と区別して整えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 贈り物の言葉は中のカードへ入れ宛名と差出人を区別すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll write that it's from me on the card inside. I'll arrange the details so my friend is clearly the recipient and I'm the sender.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will put your gift message on the card inside and distinguish the recipient from the sender.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 宛名はご友人、差出人はご自身として直す場所を確認できました。中のカードと分けて整え、発送の際にお見せください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've confirmed where to make the corrections so your friend is the recipient and you are the sender. Arrange that separately from the card inside and show us when you send it. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。本日はどのようなご用件でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What brings you here today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 町内の催しが中止になり、参加費を現金で返す係になりました。一人ずつ封筒へ入れられる紙幣を用意したいので、窓口で相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 中止した催しの参加費を返すため封筒用の紙幣を窓口で相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: A neighborhood event was canceled, and I've been assigned to refund the participation fees in cash. I'd like banknotes that I can put into separate envelopes for each person. Can I ask about that at the counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese at the counter about banknotes for envelopes to refund the fees for a canceled event.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご相談の内容を伺います。一人分の金額と、返す相手の人数は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me hear the details. Have the amount per person and the number of people receiving refunds been decided?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一人三千円で、六人です。まとめて一万八千円を渡すのではなく、六つの封筒を作って渡したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 六人へ各三千円を六つの封筒で返したいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's three thousand yen each for six people. Rather than handing over eighteen thousand yen all together, I'd like to prepare six envelopes to give them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you want to refund three thousand yen each to six people in six envelopes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 千円札なら、一つの封筒に三枚ですね。現金はもうお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: With one-thousand-yen notes, that would be three in each envelope. Do you already have the cash?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 代表から預かった一万円札二枚を持っています。返金に使う一万八千円のほかに、残る二千円も代表へ返す予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 預かった二万円から一万八千円を返金し残り二千円を代表へ返すと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have two ten-thousand-yen notes entrusted to me by the representative. Besides the eighteen thousand yen for refunds, I plan to return the remaining two thousand yen to the representative too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will use eighteen thousand yen of the entrusted twenty thousand for refunds and return the remaining two thousand to the representative.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 紙幣を用意できるかと料金は、担当に確認します。料金がかかる場合、代表の了承は取れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check with the relevant staff whether we can provide the notes and what the fee would be. If there's a fee, do you have the representative's approval?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ取れていません。参加者への返金を減らして料金に充てることはできないので、条件を聞いてから代表へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料金の了承は未取得で返金額を減らせず条件確認後に代表へ連絡すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I can't reduce the participants' refunds to cover the fee, so I'll contact the representative after hearing the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that approval for a fee has not been obtained, the refunds cannot be reduced, and you will contact the representative after checking the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、確認する間は現金をお手元で保管してください。封筒に入れる作業はご自身でされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep the cash with you while I check. Will you put it into the envelopes yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。了承が取れてから必要な紙幣を用意し、別の係と封筒ごとの三千円を確かめます。残ったお金と料金の記録も代表へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 了承後に別の係と各封筒の金額を確認し残金と料金記録も返すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. After getting approval, I'll obtain the necessary notes and check the three thousand yen in each envelope with another person in charge. I'll also give the representative the remaining money and a record of the fee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that after approval, you and another person in charge will check each envelope's amount, and you will return the remaining money and fee record too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 六人への返金と残金の扱い、ご確認が必要な点を承りました。両替の担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've noted the refunds for six people, how the remaining money is to be handled, and what you need to confirm. I'll direct you to the currency-exchange staff. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Are you looking for anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この「一袋詰め放題」は、持参した大きな袋にも詰めてよい意味でしょうか。家の袋を出す前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 詰め放題が持参の大袋も対象か袋を出す前に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Does this 'fill one bag as much as you like' offer mean I can fill the large bag I brought too? I'd like to check before getting out my own bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese, before taking out your bag, whether the fill-a-bag offer includes a large bag you brought.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 売場でお渡しする専用袋が対象です。お持ちの袋はお買い物用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The offer applies to the special bags we hand out here. Is your bag a shopping bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、普段買った物を持ち帰るための袋です。持ち帰り用と、量を決める専用袋を混同していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持ち帰り用袋と販売量を決める専用袋を混同したと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it's a bag I normally use to take my purchases home. I was confusing a bag for carrying things home with the special bag that determines the quantity sold.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you confused your take-home bag with the special bag used to measure the sale quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの袋をお使いください。袋が閉じる範囲で入れていただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please use this bag. You may fill it only as far as it will still close.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 口を閉じられるところまでですね。持参袋が大きいからその分まで入れられるとは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 専用袋が閉じる範囲で持参袋の大きさは関係しないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Up to the point where I can close the opening, right? I'll make sure I don't think I can add more just because my own bag is larger.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that the special bag must close and that the size of your own bag is irrelevant.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お願いします。対象の商品はこちらの台に並んでいます。ほかの台の商品は入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. The eligible items are on this display. Please don't put in items from other displays.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ野菜でも別の台の物は対象と決めず、こちらの台だけから選びます。詰めた後で持参袋へ移していいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象台の商品だけ選び詰めた後の持参袋移替えを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even if they're the same vegetables, I won't assume ones on another display qualify; I'll choose only from this one. May I transfer them to my own bag after filling it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will choose only from the eligible display and ask about transferring the contents to your own bag after filling it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会計前は専用袋のままお持ちください。持ち帰り用の袋へ入れるのは会計後でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep them in the special bag until you've paid. Put them into your take-home bag after checkout, please.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。専用袋が閉じるか確かめ、会計までは詰め替えず、その後に自分の袋で持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 専用袋を閉じて会計前は移さず会計後持参袋を使うと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll check that the special bag closes, leave the contents in it until checkout, and then take them home in my own bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will close the special bag, not transfer anything before checkout, and use your own bag afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。どうぞお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please go ahead and choose.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there a problem here in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 工作に使う木の部品を落としました。枝に似ていますが、自然に落ちた木ではなく私の持ち物です。清掃で捨てられる前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 落とした木製工作部品は自然の枝でなく私物と知らせ清掃前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I dropped a wooden part I use for crafts. It looks like a branch, but it's my property, not wood that fell naturally. I'd like to ask about it before it's thrown away during cleaning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese before cleaning that the wooden craft part you dropped is your property, not a natural branch.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの辺りで使っていましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ベンチのそばで模型を見せていました。園内の枝を拾って加工したわけではなく、家から持ってきた部品です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ベンチで模型を見せ家から持参し公園の枝を加工していないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was showing a model near the bench. It isn't a branch I picked up and worked on in the park; it's a part I brought from home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you were showing a model by the bench, brought the part from home, and did not work on a park branch.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 落とした部品には特徴がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Does the part you dropped have any distinguishing features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さな穴が二つあり、片側を青く塗っています。木の色だけで探すと普通の枝と間違えそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二穴と片側青色を特徴として木色だけでは探せないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: It has two small holes and is painted blue on one side. If I look just for the color of wood, I might mistake an ordinary branch for it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it has two holes and one blue side and that wood color alone will not identify it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 清掃担当にも特徴を伝えます。今、ベンチのそばに人はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell the cleaning staff about its features too. Is anyone by the bench now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 人が座っています。足元を突然探らず、声をかけてから、邪魔にならない範囲で見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 利用者の足元を突然探らず声をかけ邪魔なく探すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Someone is sitting there. I won't suddenly search around their feet; I'll speak to them first and look only where I won't get in their way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will speak to the person before looking near their feet and search without disturbing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。見つからない場合は管理事務所へ情報を残せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do that. If you can't find it, you can leave the information with the park office.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。枝の処分を止めてほしいとだけ言わず、私の木製部品の特徴と落とした場所を伝えます。見つかったらその旨も知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 枝処分停止の漠然要求でなく特徴と場所を伝え発見も知らせると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Rather than just asking you to stop throwing away branches, I'll describe my wooden part and where I dropped it. I'll let you know if I find it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that instead of vaguely asking to stop branch disposal, you will give the features and location and report if you find it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 青い部分と二つの穴がある木製部品として、落とした場所も清掃担当へ伝えます。ほかの方の足元を見る前には声をかけ、見つからなければ管理事務所へ情報を残してください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the cleaning staff that it's a wooden part with a blue section and two holes, and where you dropped it. Speak to other people before looking near their feet, and if you can't find it, leave the information with the park office. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。列車のことで何かご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you have any questions about the trains?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 表示の「十五分遅れ」を、十五時に到着する意味だと思っていました。元の時刻とどれくらい遅れるのかを分けて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十五分遅れを十五時と誤読し予定時刻と遅れを分けて尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought the display saying 'fifteen minutes late' meant it would arrive at fifteen hundred. Please explain the original time and how long the delay is separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about the scheduled time and delay separately because you misread fifteen minutes late as fifteen hundred.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 十五分は遅れの長さです。お待ちの列車の予定到着時刻はご存じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Fifteen minutes is the length of the delay. Do you know the scheduled arrival time of the train you're waiting for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予定は十四時二十分です。そこへ十五分を足すのですね。ただ、その計算だけで確定時刻だと伝えてよいのかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予定十四時二十分に十五分を足す理解と確定かを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's scheduled for fourteen twenty. So I add fifteen minutes to that, right? But I also want to check whether I can give that calculated time as a confirmed arrival time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you add fifteen minutes to the scheduled fourteen twenty, and ask whether that time is definite.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の案内では十四時三十五分頃の見込みです。状況によって変わることがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The current information is that it's expected around fourteen thirty-five. That may change depending on the situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、迎えに来る人へは十四時三十五分頃の見込みと伝えます。必ずその時刻に着くとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 迎えへ十四時三十五分頃の見込みと伝え保証しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll tell the person picking me up that it's expected around fourteen thirty-five. I won't say it will definitely arrive then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will tell the person picking you up it is expected around fourteen thirty-five without guaranteeing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お願いします。表示が更新されたら、またご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. Please check again when the display is updated.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 元の十四時二十分のまま待たせず、今の見込みを知らせます。変更があれば同じ人に改めて連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元時刻で待たせず変更時は迎えへ再連絡すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Rather than having them wait based on the original fourteen twenty time, I'll let them know the current estimate. If it changes, I'll contact the same person again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not leave the person waiting based on the original time and will contact them again if it changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。今の表示で、列車名も合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Does the train name on the current display match as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、列車名は合っています。別の列車の遅れを足さないよう、名前と予定時刻と遅れの三つを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 列車名予定時刻遅れの三つを確認して他列車と混ぜないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, the train name is correct. I'll check the name, scheduled time, and delay so I don't add another train's delay by mistake.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will check the train name, scheduled time and delay to avoid confusing it with another train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待ちの列車は現在十四時三十五分頃の見込みです。表示が変わった時は、お迎えの方にも更新をお伝えください。ご確認ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your train is currently expected around fourteen thirty-five. If the display changes, please update the person picking you up too. Thank you for checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご用件ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What can I do for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 公園の案内板が読みにくかったという意見を伝えたいです。友人も同じように感じましたが、住民全員が困っていると書くのは違うと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分と友人の案内板経験を全住民の意見とせず伝えたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to give feedback that the park information board was hard to read. My friend felt the same, but I don't think it would be right to write that all residents are having trouble.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to report your and your friend's experience with the board without presenting it as every resident's opinion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際に読みにくかった点を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you tell me exactly what was difficult to read?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 夕方、細かい地図の文字が読みにくかったです。私と友人が試した時の話で、昼間の見え方までは確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 夕方の細字が読みにくく昼間は未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: In the evening, the small lettering on the detailed map was hard to read. That's what happened when my friend and I tried it; we haven't checked how it looks in daylight.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the small letters were hard to read in the evening and that you have not checked in daylight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 時間や状況が分かると参考になります。どの公園のどの案内板ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Knowing the time and circumstances helps. Which information board in which park was it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅側の入口にある案内板です。公園内の全部の案内板を見たわけではありません。入口の一枚について伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駅側入口の一枚で全案内板ではないと具体化する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The board at the entrance on the station side. I haven't looked at every information board in the park; I want to comment on that one at the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify in Japanese that you mean the one board at the entrance on the station side, not every board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 改善の希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have any suggestions for improvement?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の地図を全部なくしてほしいのではなく、入口から主な場所への方向を大きな文字でも示してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 地図撤去でなく主な場所の方向を大きな文字でも示してほしいと提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't want the current map removed entirely. I'd like the directions from the entrance to the main places to also be shown in large letters.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Suggest in Japanese showing directions to the main places in large letters too, rather than removing the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご意見としてお預かりします。採用や変更時期をここで約束することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll take that as feedback. We can't promise here that it will be adopted or when any change might be made.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。自分たちが見た場所と時間、困った点、希望を伝えます。今日意見を出したことを、変更が決まったとは人に話しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 意見提出と変更決定は別で経験条件と希望を伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll explain where and when we looked, what was difficult, and what we'd like. I won't tell people that a change has been decided just because I gave feedback today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that submitting feedback is separate from a decision to change things and that you will report your experience's circumstances and your request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。内容を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. I'll pass your comments to the relevant staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日はどのようなことで来られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What brings you here today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ひざのことです。向かい合った人から見て右と言ってしまいましたが、私の身体では左のひざです。診察の前に言い直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相手から見た右と答えたが自分の左ひざで診察前に訂正したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's about my knee. I said right from the perspective of the person facing me, but on my own body it's my left knee. I'd like to correct that before the examination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese before the examination that you said right from the other person's view but mean your own left knee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自分の左ひざですね。今、どちらか示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your own left knee, then. Can you point to which one now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。目の前の人の右側に見えるので混同しましたが、私自身の左側です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 痛い左ひざを示し向かいの視点と混同したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This one. I mixed them up because it looks like the right side to the person in front of me, but it's my own left side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point to your painful left knee and explain in Japanese that you confused it with the perspective of the person facing you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認しました。前に記入した問診票にも右と書きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've confirmed it. Did you also write right on the medical questionnaire you filled in earlier?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、右と書いています。口頭だけ直して紙が違うままにならないよう、問診票も訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 問診票にも右と書き口頭だけでなく紙を訂正したいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I wrote right. I'd like to correct the questionnaire too so I don't just correct it verbally and leave the paper wrong.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you wrote right on the questionnaire and want to correct the paper as well as what you said.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 訂正できるようご案内します。両方のひざについての相談ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll help you make the correction. So you're not here about both knees?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は左ひざについてです。右も同じだと考えてまとめず、左のことを先生へ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日は左のみで両方を同じとまとめず説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Today I'm here about the left knee. I'll explain the left to the doctor without assuming the right is the same and grouping them together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that today you mean only the left knee and will not treat both knees as the same.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。診察時にも、ご自分の身体を基準にお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. When you're examined, please also describe it using your own body as the reference.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。身体の左ひざと言い、必要なら場所も示します。書いた側と話した側が合っているか、もう一度見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 身体基準で左と話し場所を示して書面との一致を再確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll say the left knee on my body and point to the location if necessary. I'll check once more that the side written down matches the one I mention.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will say left using your own body as the reference, point if needed, and recheck that the paperwork matches.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご自身の左ひざについてのご相談と承りました。問診票の訂正をお手伝いし、診察の担当にも左側とお伝えします。先に言い直してくださり、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've noted that your concern is your own left knee. We'll help correct the questionnaire and tell the staff conducting the examination that it's the left side too. Thank you for correcting it in advance.
